## Rgb interface

An RGB color whose channels are integers in `0..`[RGB_CHANNEL_MAX](./contracts.rgb_channel_max.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface Rgb
```

## Remarks

How a particular app represents color natively (16-bit lists, normalized `0..1` components, or something else) is a bridge concern; this type is the one SDK representation.
